prompt: Who was previously appointed prime minister of the United Kingdom, becoming the first one to win a general election since Tony Blair in 2005?
answer: Sir Keir Starmer. He became prime minister on 5 July 2024 after Labour’s general-election victory, becoming the first Labour leader to win an election since Tony Blair in 2005.
